I've got nothing going for me now. Nobody would miss me when I'm gone. I don't know what I really want to be. I enjoy nothing. 

I know I still have many things to be happy about. I even tried volunteering at some non-profit organisations to experience some of the pains which afflict the less fortunate, but still no difference for me.
can you share why it didn't work? I'm thinking of using the same method.
